requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity solutions for print, scan, and workflow management, tailored for SMBs with minimal IT support.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for efficient management and automation in SMBs lacking dedicated IT, delivering breakthrough productivity as a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration and compatible hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI solutions are available for print, scan, and workflow tasks; demonstrated efficiency gains in SMB pilot tests.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a unified portal for device management, enabling Office Managers and Generalist IT staff to easily manage multiple printers from a single interface.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/Lightly Managed SMBs require simple, centralized management to reduce IT burden and improve control.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend portal development and printer firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows management of at least 6-15 printers, supports key admin tasks, and is validated by user testing with SMBs.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to achieve HP’s lowest business TCO in the SMB segment, focusing on minimal intervention, high yield, and cost-efficient consumables.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value ROI and efficiency; lowest TCO is a primary purchase driver and competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires high-yield consumables, efficient hardware design, and supply chain optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO analysis demonstrates lowest cost in segment compared to key competitors (Epson, Canon).

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be easily swapped by the customer, reducing service calls and printer downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance burden for SMBs with limited IT resources and addresses new customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware redesign and documentation for end-user replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by users without tools in under 5 minutes, validated in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refill
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility, minimizing user errors and support incidents.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces support costs by preventing ink mix-ups.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design of bottle and tank interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are only compatible with correct tank, validated by lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, to align with SMB usage patterns and expectations.
requirements.Rationale: Supports SMB purchasing decisions and provides assurance for high-usage environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires durability testing and warranty policy alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are included in product materials and supported by reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability – PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Enable customer-replaceable PHA components and MINK servicing at authorized centers, targeting customer replaceability as the preferred threshold if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and support costs for SMBs, improving satisfaction and reducing service expenses.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for replaceability and service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA parts are customer-replaceable; MINK service available at centers; validated in service trials.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Provide SMB2.0 solutions and an Advanced View SMB portal for non-PDL SKUs, supporting Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) models.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses specific SMB management needs and enables new business models (PaaS).
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software development and integration with hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB2.0 and Advanced View portal are functional and available at launch for non-PDL SKUs.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Improved Speed and Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: PDL SKUs must support improved print speeds (25/20 ppm) and meet Blue Angel environmental standards.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for performance and sustainability in higher-end SKUs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware optimization, compliance testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm and passes Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Features
requirements.Description: Deliver advanced print and scan quality features, leveraging AI to ensure optimal output with minimal user intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB need for professional-quality documents without expert setup.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software and sensor integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print and scan quality meets or exceeds defined benchmarks in SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Design the product using at least 60% recycled content plastic, surpassing competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses growing customer and regulatory demand for sustainable products.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and manufacturing process changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Third-party audit confirms at least 60% RCP in product materials.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing and device management via the HP App, supporting common SMB workflows.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs increasingly rely on mobile devices for business operations; app integration is a user expectation.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires app development and printer firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile print and management features available in HP App and validated with SMB users.

requirements.Title: PaaS Enablement
requirements.Description: Support Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) models to allow flexible, usage-based billing and management for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables new business models and recurring revenue streams for HP, aligning with market trends.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP’s PaaS infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features available and functional for eligible SKUs at launch.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry capabilities to collect device usage, performance, and health data for proactive support and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables HP and SMBs to monitor device health, optimize usage, and reduce downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure data collection and privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, transmitted securely, and accessible via portal; meets privacy standards.

requirements.Title: Advanced Security and Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets enterprise-grade security and regulatory compliance requirements relevant for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Protects SMB customers from security threats and ensures compliance with local regulations.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires security features and regulatory review.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes security and compliance audits for target markets.
